Introduction.mission: Virtus International School educates children according to the standards required for admission to the world's most prestigious “Top 100” universities and fully supports them in preparing for these entrance exams.
Introduction.missionAccent: We guarantee your child's admission to the TOP 100 universities on a grant basis. Otherwise, the payment is 100% refunded!
Introduction.campusText: The VIS building stands out with its spacious and modern infrastructure. The school is equipped with all the necessary amenities, providing an ideal environment for students to receive an effective education.
Introduction.classroomText: The classrooms at Virtus International School are specially designed to provide students with the most comfortable and effective learning environment possible.

items.title: Ergonomic furniture
items.text: The desks and chairs in the classrooms are chosen to help students sit comfortably and stay focused. Ergonomic furniture supports the proper development of the skeletal system.

items.title: Lighting and sunlight
items.text: The windows in the classrooms are located on the left side, allowing natural sunlight to stream in from the optimal direction for reading and writing.

items.title: Board distance
items.text: The distance between the board and students is 90–170 cm, ensuring clear visibility for all students and preventing shadows while writing.

items.title: Ventilation and temperature
items.text: Classrooms are fully equipped with ventilation and heating systems, maintaining optimal temperature and humidity for enhanced focus and student health.

FourPillars.heading: The four pillars of our educational approach

items.title: Logical thinking:
items.text: VIS places great importance on developing students’ logical thinking and analytical approach. Logic and analysis are the foundation of any decision-making process and are key to the students’ success in life.

items.title: Creative approach:
items.text: We teach our students to approach real-life problems creatively and practically. This approach helps them avoid unproductive solutions and use resources efficiently.

items.title: Independent thinking:
items.text: VIS teaches students to think independently and adhere to their life principles without succumbing to external influences. This enables them to benefit from various situations and make the most effective decisions.

items.title: Finding the best solutions in various situations:
items.text: We teach our students to analyze various situations and make the most beneficial decisions for themselves. They learn to act effectively without being distracted by unproductive details or emotions.

Amenities.title: All the amenities for effective learning

facilities.title: Laboratories and practical rooms
facilities.desc: The private school's laboratory and hands-on classrooms provide students with unique opportunities to experiment and apply theoretical knowledge into practice. The rooms are equipped with modern equipment that serves to develop deep learning of sciences and scientific thinking.

facilities.title: Year-round sports halls
facilities.desc: Winter sports hall – 12×30 meters, equipped with changing rooms and showers. Sports field – 16×32 meters, suitable for volleyball, tennis, football and basketball. Hall for gymnastics, karate, wrestling and other sports clubs.

facilities.title: A cafeteria with a capacity of 600 seats
facilities.desc: The large cafeteria provides convenience for students during lunch breaks. The spacious area allows all students to dine without lines or crowds. The ample dining space encourages interaction and a friendly atmosphere, strengthening the school community.

facilities.title: Library with a capacity of 50 students
facilities.desc: The library provides students with a wide range of academic resources, enhancing their knowledge and love for reading. It offers comfortable space for independent study with librarians available to assist based on students’ needs.

staffTop.title: Experienced teachers
staffTop.text: Our qualified and experienced teachers use modern educational methods to provide an individual approach to each student, helping them unlock their potential.

staffTop.title: Professional psychologists
staffTop.text: School psychologists support students’ emotional well-being, provide counseling, and create a conducive environment for their development.

staffTop.title: Strict supervision
staffTop.text: We strictly monitor students’ discipline and academic performance, maintaining high educational standards.

Amenities.tutorText: Each student is assigned a personal tutor who monitors their academic and disciplinary development, maintains daily communication with parents, and holds meetings every quarter.
Amenities.facultyTitle: Faculty from the world's top 100 universities
Amenities.facultyText: Experts from leading universities around the world conduct lectures and masterclasses, preparing students for admission to the best higher education institutions.

ComprehensiveCoverage.title: Comprehensive coverage of all aspects
ComprehensiveCoverage.descText: You no longer need to enroll your child in various extracurricular activities and tutors. We will take care of the comprehensive development of your child.

cards.title: Programming and robotics
cards.description: Students learn the fundamentals of programming, participate in robotics competitions and hackathons, and develop computational thinking skills for the digital age.

cards.title: Team sports
cards.description: Football, basketball and volleyball training develops teamwork, discipline and physical fitness. Students compete in inter-school tournaments and regional championships.

cards.title: Martial arts
cards.description: Karate, judo and self-defense classes build confidence, physical coordination and mental discipline. Students train under certified instructors.

cards.title: Scientific clubs
cards.description: Hands-on physics, chemistry and biology experiments develop scientific thinking. Students work on research projects and participate in science olympiads.

items.q: What ages does Virtus International School accept?
items.a: Virtus International School enrolls children aged 4 to 19. New students are admitted from age 4 up to age 15. Each class has 18-20 students, ensuring an individual approach and effective learning for every child. With fewer students per class, teachers can better identify each student's needs and abilities.

We offer three specialized tracks: Exact Sciences (mathematics, physics, IT), Natural Sciences (chemistry, biology, geography), and Social Sciences (history, law, economics, business management). Mathematics and English are taught in depth across all directions, ensuring students are internationally competitive.

Grants are awarded as tuition discounts ranging from 5% to 100%, based on competitive entrance examinations. The number of full (100%) grants is limited to 50 places. Grants are awarded for one academic quarter and reviewed each quarter — to keep a grant, a student must remain within the Top 5 of their grade and uphold the school's IB disciplinary standards.

items.q: Who can apply for a grant, and how are candidates assessed?
items.a: Candidates aged 11–15 (MYP) sit written exams in three tracks — Exact Sciences (mathematics, physics, computer science), Natural Sciences (chemistry, biology), and Humanities (history, law, etc.). Exams are held on campus and conducted in English. Children aged 4–10 (PYP) take part in an interview with a psychologist, alongside an assessment of the family's social profile.

items.q: How long is the academic year?
items.a: The academic year lasts 10 months, from September 2nd to June 30th.

items.q: Do you offer a summer program?
items.a: Yes — we offer a summer program to help children prepare for our school's entrance exams.

items.q: How does the school support students' well-being?
items.a: Every 40-50 students are assigned a personal mentor who monitors academic and disciplinary development and maintains daily communication with parents. Professional psychologists support students' emotional well-being, and special adaptation programs help new students adjust to the school environment. You can track your child's progress through our Telegram bot.
